senses.gloss: m. (preced., cmp. b. h. צוּר) mount, mountain.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 23:2">Targ. Y. Gen. XXIII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:3">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ תלג</he> a mountain of snow (my head is white).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32:10">Gen. R. s. 32</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01288"><he>בְּרַךְ</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>טוּרִין</he>, <he>טוּרַיָּא</he>, <he>טוּרֵי</he>, <cite ref="I00156"><he>טַוְו׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 9:5">Targ. Job. IX, 5</cite>.
Targ. Deut. XI, 11; a. fr.—Gen. R. l. c. אי מט׳ רמיא if it belongs among the high mountains; a. e.—[Sabb. 98ᵇ כי טירין, v. טָרִיז.]—טור מלכא (h. הר המלך) King’s Mountain, ט׳ שמעון Mount Simeon.
Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ; Lam. R. to II, 2 (v. Neub. Géogr. p. 41; p. 267).—ט׳ פרזלא Iron Mount.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 34:3">Targ. Y. Num. XXXIV, 3</cite>.—For other compounds, v. respective determinants.
